title.narrative: Outcome 1: Students at FGU and vocational schools gain more knowledge about the World Goals and development work and experience that they can play a role for the World Goals and a better world.

Outcome indicator 1.0: The primary indicators of the students gained knowledge are their participation in workshop courses and their qualitative and quantitative feedback from this. All the students (148 respondents) who have participated in the project and received teaching at workshops with ViH have been asked to relate to the following statements on a rank scale from 1-10, respectively before and after a workshop course:
Statement 1. I know what the Global Goals are about Statement 2. I think the Global Goals are relevant to me Statement 3. I am interested in what is happening in the world Statement 4. I can contribute to making the world a better place for myself and others

Statement 4: Before the workshop, the students answer an average of 6.8 on a scale from 1-10 with ViH.

title.narrative: Outcome 2: Students gain an increased understanding of and experience with how they can use their acquired knowledge and newfound engagement to engage peers and increase their democratic self-confidence.

The primary indicators that the students have gained an increased understanding of and experience with communicating the World Goals and global cases are the students' participation in public meetings and festivals, as well as their qualitative and quantitative feedback.
In order to examine the above outcome, the students who participated at Ungdommens Folkemøde (5 classes/48 respondents) were asked to relate to the following statements, respectively before the workshop and after completion.
1. I feel that decision makers take me seriously 2. I can contribute to making the world a better place for myself or others

actual.value:
Statement 1: Students answer before the workshop course with ViH, on a scale from 1-10 an average of 4.0.
Statement 2: Before the workshop, the students answer with ViH on a scale from 1-10 an average of 6.4.

Statement 1: The students answer an average of 5.2 on a scale from 1-10.
Statement 2: The students answer on a scale from 1-10 an average of 7.2

title.narrative: Outcome 3: Sustainable bridge-building is being created between youth life in the north and south and between Danida's partners in development work and students from vocational education.

The primary indicators that contact has been created between young people in the north and south, as well as between Danida's partners and students from FGUs and vocational schools, are the extent of the involvement of Danida's partners in the workshop courses, the extent of exchanges and meetings between young people in the north and south, as well as the qualitative and quantitative feedback of the students, schools and Danida's partners.
In order to examine the above outcome, the students who participated at Ungdommens Folkemøde (5 classes/48 respondents) were asked to relate to the following statements, respectively. before the workshop and after completion on the platform:
1. I am interested in what is happening in the world
The students have been asked to decide how much they agree with the above statement on a scale of 1-10. After the completion of the Youth People's Meeting, the students have also been asked to relate to the following statements:
2. The project has given me a better understanding of young people who live outside Europe

actual.value: Statement 1: According to the Youth People's Meeting, the students answer on a scale from 1-10 an average of 7.4. Statement 2: After Ungdommens Folkemøde, the students answer on a scale from 1-10 an average of 7.1
Statement 1: Students answer before the workshop with ViH on a scale from 1-10 an average of 6.2.
